chunks: They said: "O Minister, he has an aged father, so keep one of us in his place. We see you are a virtuous man."

key_terms.الْعَزِيزُ: The Minister or Vizier (title for Joseph)

ai.seo_question: What argument did Joseph's brothers use to persuade the Vizier to keep one of them in Egypt?
ai.summary: In this verse, the brothers appeal to Joseph's mercy by highlighting their father Jacob's advanced age and deep sorrow, framing Benjamin's potential loss as a fatal blow to their patriarch. Their assertion that Joseph is 'among the doers of good' (min al-muhsinin) reflects the Shia scholarly view of Joseph's inherent virtue and his role as a model of patience and familial devotion. This moment underscores the theme of divine providence, where the brothers' ignorance of Joseph's true identity contrasts with their sincere, albeit temporary, recognition of his moral stature.
